entities.name: Authentication failure parameter
entities.description: Information element sent when EMM cause is #21 'synch failure'. Contains the AUTS parameter which is the response to the authentication challenge from the USIM.

entities.name: EMM cause #21 synch failure
entities.description: EMM cause value indicating synchronization failure that triggers the inclusion of the authentication failure parameter.

entities.name: AUTS parameter
entities.description: Response to the authentication challenge from the USIM, included within the authentication failure parameter.

relations.description: Authentication failure parameter is sent only when EMM cause is #21 'synch failure'.
Authentication failure parameter includes the AUTS parameter as its content.
